shortDescription: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the decision to include Russia in this year's Group of 20 meetings after criticism from the European Union and other allies, saying dialogue is the only way to end the war in Ukraine, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Rubio Backs Russia's G20 Attendance Despite Allied Criticism
